title: Refinements Are Erased from URL When No Results Are Found
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

When using a custom filter implementation on the /search page `(fetching facets from _rawResults)`, the applied filters `(facetFilters)` are removed from the URL when a search returns no results. This does not happen on the /category page, where Algolia's built-in RefinementList widget is used.

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

1. Go to /search and enter a search query.
2. Apply a filter from the custom filter UI.
3. If results exist, the filters remain in the URL.
4. If no results are found, the search re-triggers an API request without facetFilters, removing them from the URL.
5. Compare this behavior with /category, where the facetFilters remain intact.

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/p/github/daryldeogracias/algolia-web-app/chore/refinementlist

### 💭 Expected behavior

1. `facetFilters` should persist in the URL even when no results are found, just like on the /category page.
2. and it should not  re-trigger a search request when no results are found.

### Package version

"next": "^15.1.6", "react-instantsearch": "^7.15.3", "react-instantsearch-nextjs": "^0.4.4", "algoliasearch": "^5.20.0", "instantsearch.js": "^4.77.3",
